description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class in the ai.openclaw.app.node package, specifically testing the handling of system notifications with various scenarios.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of SystemHandler's system notification handling methods.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster used to simulate posting notifications and verify interactions.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that throws exceptions to test error handling.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that unauthorized posts are rejected with the correct error code.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Tests that empty notifications are rejected with INVALID_REQUEST error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests that invalid notification objects missing required fields are rejected.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Tests that valid notifications are successfully posted.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Tests that optional fields are correctly trimmed and passed on.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Verifies that permission errors during posting return NOT_AUTHORIZED.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Verifies that unexpected exceptions during posting return UNAVAILABLE with appropriate message.
